title: Implement bounded Math interpolation, natural spline and least squares
commitMessage: feat: add bounded numerical interpolation and regression contracts and open M6

contribution.summary: Start M6 with a real net10 dw.tools.math.analysis library for bounded finite binary64 linear interpolation, natural cubic splines and unweighted least squares. Compile one absent-API RED, pass 47 independent GREEN tests, retain four Math regression suites and independently verify a SHA-inspected local NuGet package through eight package-only consumer probes. Qualify y=2x+1, interpolation at 0.5 = 2 and typed refusals; complete C01-T1 only, leaving T2, work packages and M6 open.
contribution.value: Introduce an independently consumable bounded .NET Math analysis package with real interpolation, spline and descriptive regression contracts, exact acceptance examples and explicit approximation/refusal provenance rather than a planned empty project.
debtChanges: Create lowercase analysis and MSTest net10 project files, locked dependency manifests and solution entries without multiplying empty package assemblies.
Observe one genuine compiled absent public BoundedCurveAnalysis64 API RED before introducing its implementation, keeping missing API distinct from compiler failure.
Implement finite provider-free 2–32 sample linear and natural cubic interpolation plus descriptive ordinary least squares with typed refusals.
Qualify 47 independent scientific and boundary GREEN tests including y=2x+1, zero SSE, curved spline 0.6875, duplicate/outside-range and rank-deficient samples.
Run locked Release build, the full new analysis test project and focused existing numerics, quantities, IR and composition regressions, not routine full solution tests.
Pack and independently SHA-check the actual 1.1.0-preview.1 local Math analysis nupkg; restore a pinned isolated NuGet-only console and verify eight hand oracles.
Advance only M6-W01-C01-T1 RED/GREEN/VERIFY, opening M6/W01/C01 while preserving T2, other work packages, public NuGet and stable release gates as future scope.
contribution.nextAction: After RS081 durable success, prepare M6-W01-C01-T2 for extrapolation, duplicate/conditioning, units and scientific loss boundaries; do not promote release M6 or public stable 1.1.
